notes: Raw profiles were preserved then cleared before this independent measurement; compiled artifacts and previous reports retained.

The default shared-target report included historical executables and mismatched profiles. Published totals use all 11 current Cargo workspace executables, including all 10 executed test binaries; no current workspace source was omitted. See #251.

Workspace entrypoint mtimes were refreshed without changing bytes to avoid stale cross-worktree Cargo artifacts. Corrected export has zero mismatched functions, duplicate logical paths, or reused foreign source paths.

Three focused ordering regressions passed: concurrent messages do not change last-end recency; all terminal outcomes count independent of vector order; missing ends fall back to creation, not message/observation time. Existing settled grouping, filters, and deterministic identity ties remain unchanged.
No manual TUI or live-provider journey was performed for this delivery. Linux workspace tests do not establish native macOS/Windows behavior. Coverage measures execution, not correctness.

Compared with previous account-main measurement: lines +0.0535 percentage points, functions +0.0727 percentage points, regions +0.0608 percentage points. Measurement scope and exclusions are unchanged.
